text: The ∞-categorical analogue of 'every category has a nerve' is:
choices: Every ∞-category has a realisation as a complete Segal space
The coherent nerve gives an equivalence between homotopy-coherent categories and quasicategories
All of the above (different but equivalent presentations)
explanation: Different models of ∞-categories are all equivalent via Quillen equivalences; nerve/realisation go between models.
